purpose: Bridges PR #15 Method & Failure Memory (E0-E6: ORIGIN -> EXPLORE -> FAIL -> QUESTION -> FIX -> LOCK) with PR #5 Layered Evidence READ / State-Dependent Skill Router and PR #11 Geometry-Locked Tile & Hole Return Acceptance Gates.
traceability_law: Every method_id maps 1-to-1 to an executable Python module/function, explicit preconditions, mathematical invariants, historical failure modes, executable test_ids, and an independent S7 acceptance gate.

e_timeline_memory_index.core_question: 物件邊界未完整，能否開始幾何擬合？

lifecycle.ORIGIN: Attempted geometric bbox fitting on unverified partial contours.
lifecycle.EXPLORE: Tested direct 4-corner fitting before silhouette completion.
lifecycle.FAIL: Clipped pilot right cheek (x=702) and merged background orange machine into left arm.
lifecycle.QUESTION: Can geometric fitting start before the whole-object boundary is complete?
lifecycle.FIX: Require S1/S3 whole-object closed silhouette verification (or True Empty-BG Reverse Clipping) BEFORE any geometric fitting.
lifecycle.LOCK: Precondition `boundary_complete_verified == True` enforced by Skill Router (routes to OTL0_TOPOLOGY_REPAIR if false).

e_timeline_memory_index.core_question: 為甚麼單機成功、六機失敗？是否偷偷換掉成功前提？

lifecycle.ORIGIN: Single studio object extraction succeeded on clean white/dark studio backdrop.
lifecycle.EXPLORE: Applied single-object studio colour threshold directly to multi-mecha hangar scene.
lifecycle.FAIL: Hangar clutter (yellow railing, ceiling girders, orange cart) violated the clean-backdrop assumption.
lifecycle.QUESTION: Why did single-mecha succeed while multi-subject hangar scene failed?
lifecycle.FIX: Explicitly record `same_coordinate_empty_bg_available` as a precondition; use True In-Place Empty-BG Reverse Clipping (`||I_scene - I_empty_bg||`).

e_timeline_memory_index.core_question: 部件是結構樹，還是只是切割區域？

lifecycle.ORIGIN: Sliced image into uniform rectangular grid tiles (`guillotine_grid_cut`).
lifecycle.FAIL: Guillotine cuts sliced across pilot face, quad optical lenses, and torso joints (`E-SHQ-91`).
lifecycle.QUESTION: Are parts a hierarchical anatomical/mechanical structure tree (`part_of`), or mere crop regions?
lifecycle.FIX: Enforce `L0 Scene -> L1 Subject -> L2 Whole Part -> L3 Sub-Component` tree with `guillotine_grid_cut_used == False`.
lifecycle.LOCK: Invariant `is_complete_physical_part == True` and `part_of` acyclic graph check.

e_timeline_memory_index.core_question: 能切像素是否就等於認得部件？

lifecycle.ORIGIN: Auto-thresholded contour masks were labeled as semantic parts without evidence verification.
lifecycle.EXPLORE: Evaluated contour extraction vs semantic recognition.
lifecycle.FAIL: Stray text label 'L' and background gaps were misclassified as arm armor.
lifecycle.QUESTION: Does cutting pixels equal recognizing the semantic part?
lifecycle.FIX: Separate S1/S2 `candidate` contour + observable `evidence_bbox` from S3 human-verified semantic truth.

e_timeline_memory_index.core_question: 教學框與實際執行框是否真的重疊？

lifecycle.ORIGIN: Teaching diagram showed 8 part boxes, but Python execution used mismatched donor coordinates.
lifecycle.EXPLORE: Measured IoU and center offset between teaching locate boxes and execution write boxes.
lifecycle.FAIL: Horizontal flip and donor coordinate mismatch caused ghosting and severe misregistration.
lifecycle.QUESTION: Do the teaching boxes and actual execution boxes truly overlap in the same coordinate frame?
lifecycle.FIX: Lock recursive transform chain `T_{scene<-leaf} = T_{scene<-L1} * T_{L1<-L2} * T_{L2<-leaf}` with `det(R) > 0` (no mirror flip) and `phase_shift_px <= 0.1`.

e_timeline_memory_index.core_question: 矩形 peep 能否當作真實剪影洞？densify 是否令物件變大？

lifecycle.ORIGIN: Used rectangular `peep` box as edit mask and resized freeframe densified crop to fill `peep`.
lifecycle.FAIL: Rectangular peep leaked background pixels; silent resize hid wrong-sized HD outputs and inflated object scale.
lifecycle.QUESTION: Can a rectangular peep replace a true closed silhouette hole, and did densify inflate the object?
lifecycle.FIX: Enforce binary closed silhouette `M_hole in {0, 255}`, ban silent resize in `anti_diff` and `hardpaste_hole`, and enforce `max_grow` on true object silhouette contour.

methods.purpose: 在任何升清或細節增強前，先修復物件邊界與部件拓撲錯誤（拓撲優先定律）
當檢測到身份漂移且具備已核實身份參考圖時，執行 ECC 幾何與身份鎖定修復
針對皮膚或平滑裝甲表面噪點散射進行受控去噪與零相位保邊
在原物件洞形（閉合剪影 M_hole）內增加細節，嚴格鎖定物件尺寸與洞外零洩漏（洞／除／扣／生四態標準法）
固定 4x 學習式超分（或帶 Halo/Core 互斥寫入契約的 Tile 升頻），僅取各 Tile Core 寫回 4x 母圖
在已具備 4x Master 與已核實材質遮罩的前提下，於閉合剪影內生成 3D 多面體金屬織紋與機械微結構
